seatedToss.guidance: Mwicare ku meza, mukinanire gutera umufuka muto w’ibishyimbo mu gisasu kinini. Mwandikire amanota ku mpapuro, hamwe.
steps: Mucapishe igisasu n’urupapuro rwo kwandikaho amanota, mubishyire hasi ku meza hagati yanyu.
Mwicare neza, umwe ku ruhande rumwe, undi ku rundi. Buri wese agatera rimwe mu bwitonde, cangwa mwihorere niba mutabishaka.
Igihe umufuka uguye mu ruziga, uwateye ashyiraho akamenyetso mu kazu k’inkingi ye, ku murongo w’urwo ruziga.
Nimba mushaka, mureba hamwe utumenyetso igihe muhagaritse. Nta wugomba kubara ibyo ari byo byose.
Muhagarike igihe cyose umwe muri mwe ashatse.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Mukoreshe umufuka gusa ufite igifuniko cyadodeshejwe cyangwa isogisi yazingiye, mwicare, ntimutere mu maso na hamwe, kandi mugume umuntu mukuru hafi. Utuntu duto dushobora gufunga umuhogo.
flags: Ntibikwiye ku bari munsi y’imyaka 3: utuntu duto
safety: Hitamo umufuka w’ibishyimbo ufite igifuniko cyadodeshejwe, cyangwa uzingire isogisi isukuye. Mbere na mbere, mugenzure niba nta mwobo cyangwa udodo ruhuye, kugira ngo nta kintu gisohoke mu mufuka.
Ibishyimbo, umuceri n’ibindi bintu bito byuzuza umufuka bishobora gufunga umuhogo. Bigumane kure y’abana bato n’umuntu wese ushyira ibintu mu kanwa.
Mugume hafi, kandi mwitegereze neza nimba hari ikintu gishobora gushyirwa mu kanwa.
Mugume mwicaye. Mutere buhoro kandi hasi, mu gisasu kiri ku meza, ntimutere mu maso na hamwe.
seatedToss.previewLabel: Urupapuro rwacapwe: igisasu gifite uruziga rutatu rwitwa Hafi, Hagati na Kure, uhereye hanze ugana imbere, n’urupapuro rwo kwandikaho amanota rufite inkingi ku muntu wese n’imirongo y’utuzu tuza ubusa ku ruziga rwose.
seatedToss.sheetHow: Mubishyire hasi hagati yanyu. Igihe umufuka uguye mu ruziga, mushyireho akamenyetso mu kazu k’inkingi yanyu, ku murongo w’urwo ruziga.

decorateACard.guidance: Hitamo impamvu yo kwandika ikarata, hanyuma muyirimbishe hamwe mukoresheje amakaramu y’amabara cyangwa ikaramu. Nta karata imwe ikwiye kuruta izindi.

steps.fold: Mucapishe ikarata, mugapfundike mo kabiri ku murongo w’utudomo, kugira ngo uruhande rw’imbere rube hanze.
steps.front: Umwe muri mwe arimbisha uruhande rw’imbere, hirya no hino y’amagambo.

Mwandike ubutumwa hamwe, canke umwe yandike ivyo uwundi avuga.

steps: Capisha impapuro zose. Urupapuro rwa mbere ni aya mabwiriza hamwe n'ikarita y'urukuta.
Umuntu wese afate urupapuro rumwe cangwa nyinshi maze arisige amabara.
Amabara n'uburyo bwo gushushanya ntibigomba kuba bimwe. Impapuro zose ziba igice cy'ishusho imwe.
Shyira impapuro ku murongo ukurikije ibirango, hanyuma uzifatanye ukoresheje scotch inyuma.
Shyira urukuta ahantu bose bashobora kurureba.

conversationCards.groupSit: Mwicare mu ruziga aho bose babona ishusho neza. Uwufite ikarita, cyangwa igikoresho gifite ishusho nini, asoma igitekerezo mbere mu ijwi riranguruye.
conversationCards.groupPass: Hanyuma ikarita ihabwe undi. Buri muntu avuga ijambo cyangwa interuro ku bijanye n'ishusho, hanyuma ayihe undi.
conversationCards.groupNoSpeech: Guhereza ikarita ntibibujijwe na rimwe. Umuntu ashobora gusimbuka nta cyo avuze, kandi nta muntu usabwa gusobanura impamvu.
conversationCards.groupEnd: Umuzingo urarangira igihe ikarita imaze kuzenguruka uruziga rwose, cyangwa igihe itsinda rimaze kunyurwa. Nta n'umwe utsinze. Mushobora guhagarara igihe cose itsinda rishaka.

photoPairs.guidance: Kanda ifoto, hanyuma ukande iyihuye nayo.
photoPairs.intro: **Hitamo amafoto 2 kugeza ku 6** ku gikoresho. Yerekanwa kuri iyi paje gusa, ntiyoherezwa canke ngo abikwe.
photoPairs.empty: Amafoto yawe azagaragara hano, buri foto inshuro ebyiri.

pictureBingo.guidance: Banza ucapishe amakarita. Hanyuma werekane uwo muhamagaro ku ecran nini ufite.
pictureBingo.start: Kanda "Ishusho ikurikira" kugira uhamagare ishusho ya mbere.

calmBreathing.guidance: Injiza impwemu uko uruziga rwiyongera, uzisohore uko rugabanuka. Rurihagarika rwonyene inyuma yo guhema gatandatu.
calmBreathing.started: Vyatanguye. Injiza impwemu uko uruziga rwiyongera.
calmBreathing.finished: Uko kwari guhema gatandatu buhoro buhoro. Musubire mutangure igihe cose mushakiye.

storyChain.guidance: Mugende mu ruhererekane: buri wese avuge interuro imwe maze yongereho ifoto ikurikira.
storyChain.passNote: Mwivugire interuro yanyu mu ijwi riranguruye. Nta kintu cyandikwa cyangwa ngo kibikwe. Umuntu wese ashobora kurenga.
storyChain.full: Ruhererekane rufite amafoto umunani yose. Muvuge inkuru yose, cyangwa mutangire urundi ruhererekane.
